rationale: The captured context from AMLAS v1.1 Model Learning (printed pp. 32–34) directly supports each element of the claim: Note 29 addresses overfitting to development data; Example 26 illustrates overfitting where simulator image artifacts serve as spurious noise/boundaries for hazardous classes; Activity 11 and footnote 5 explicitly warn against data leakage from internal test data during iterative model development; and Artefact [U] explicitly requires a model development log that documents and justifies all key decisions made during the learning process.
evidence_locators: AMLAS v1.1, PDF pp. 33–35 (printed pp. 32–34), Model Learning Stage, Note 29, Example 26, Artefact [U], Activity 11, and Footnote 5
limitations: Inspection is restricted to the provided AMLAS v1.1 guidance text; AMLAS is research guidance rather than regulatory approval, and these examples illustrate risk mechanisms rather than diagnosing any specific operational deployment.
